first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Register the Spring Boot cohort and replay its first five callers
commits.body:
Bind all 50 pull requests and 150 registered questions to the brief and original build records. Examples 588–592 compile each caller on the parent and replay unchanged class files against both artifact sets. They observe nested system-property restoration, typed constructor defaults, direct and YAML map binding, wildcard validation beside a concrete constraint, and the JDK properties comparison.

All 30 fresh JVM reports reproduced in a second replay. All 15 merged predictions matched, the cohort audit reconciled the receipts, example validation passed and all 38 change-selected suites passed.

commits.summary: Exercise Flyway migrations in native images (verification pending)
commits.body:
Compile the original parent and merge on 28 byte-pinned application dependencies apiece. Each resource layout gets a separate image and database, an original Flyway history read and an independent JDBC read. Ordinary and Spring AOT JVMs applied version 2 with checksum -391086276 and marker 73 on both nested profiles and the merged root profile.

Jobs 20261127-132635-run-three-genuine-flyway-native-sql-layo and 20261127-132636-run-three-genuine-flyway-native-sql-layo build and execute the three real native images on the fix and parent respectively. The host JVM results do not establish the native behavior.

commits.summary: Measure Spring Boot callers across 17 more PRs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Add original application, JDBC, Micrometer, JSON, and archive callers. S08 resolved ordinary indexed messages but missed a comma-bearing basename. S26 returned a ValueWrapper around the correct named-cache value. S12 created a dependency after close on the parent but did not recreate it on the merge. The campaign now covers 66 questions on 22 PRs, with 131 original JVM results. Record the independent setup test outcomes for the whole cohort separately.

The 17 added examples passed validation with a second JVM replay, all 38 changed-file suites passed, and the audit checked the registered predictions, artifact identities and every receipt. Job 20261127-132243-reproduce-the-first-22-spring-boot-publi independently recompiles the 22 callers and compares the complete audit.

commits.summary: Test incremental metadata and Gradle layers (verification pending)
commits.body:
Exercise actual consumer builds using the original Spring Boot plugins. For metadata, check javac’s parsed source list and the two JSON descriptions after editing or removing a comment. For layers, expand the generated index and verify ownership and compiled bytes for three selectors. The input preflight validated 97 files per S10 revision and 95 per S47 revision against the frozen digests and checked each plugin descriptor.

Jobs 20261127-133810-compare-actual-incremental-gradle-proper and 20261127-133810-read-actual-spring-boot-gradle-layer-own run the separate offline Gradle distributions and inspect their outputs. The replay module compiles and the 60 change-selected suites passed.

commits.summary: Replay Spring Boot HTTP, SQL and loader histories (verification pending)
commits.body:
Twelve more examples use identical callers on original deployments. Both Tomcat and Jetty now wait for the last admitted request after restart. Two original H2 databases show the old secondary-pool rollback leaving a flushed row. The repaired Boot archive still loses package version 1.2.3 if its first lookup in that package misses. Redis and Kafka option readbacks stay separate from their live timing claims.

All 12 examples passed fresh replay and repository validation and all 60 affected suites passed. The campaign audit checks 195 public observations. Job 20261127-134852-repeat-34-original-spring-boot-public-ap independently repeats the full 34-case audit on this revision.

commits.summary: Check Maven WAR attributes at their public goal (verification pending)
commits.body:
Add a consumer to the original upstream Maven integration harness on each S48 pin. Maven WAR 3.5.1 packages a known file and the original Boot goal repackages it. The fixture opens the final archive and reads the manifest, the selected bytes and the position of a distinctly named second CycloneDX file. The launcher checked both original revisions, Gradle distributions and test harnesses before submission.

Jobs 20261127-141531-inspect-maven-repackaged-spring-boot-par and 20261127-141531-inspect-maven-repackaged-spring-boot-fix run the full Maven builds in private copies of the source. The numbered public Repackager exercise is an independent check of the same layout.

commits.summary: Resolve the original Maven BOMs offline (verification pending)
commits.body:
The two Maven jobs stopped before building the consumer because the Gradle metadata did not recognize the cached ActiveMQ 6.1.8 POM. The exact POM is present in both prepared caches. The build now exposes its local Maven-layout copy to Gradle for release BOMs as well as to Maven, preserving each original source pin and the offline boundary.

Validated the pinned checkout and launcher. Job 20261127-142145-resolve-the-pinned-maven-boms-from-the-r repeats the fixed build before the parent.

commits.summary: Use retained POMs for detached Gradle resolution (verification pending)
commits.body:
The detached @pom lookup stayed tied to its original remote repository. In the temporary build tooling only, resolve immutable release BOMs by their original coordinates in the local Maven-layout mirror. Check each Gradle POM against its SHA-1 directory and keep large integration build work off tmpfs. The two Spring Boot production trees and Maven goals are unchanged.

The cached ActiveMQ BOM is present in both original caches, the fixed input preflight passed, and job 20261127-142917-read-retained-pom-bytes-at-the-original exercises the full scoped build.

commits.summary: Validate short Gradle cache digest names (verification pending)
commits.body:
Gradle omitted the leading zero in the SHA-1 directory for the retained ANTLR POM. Pad its hexadecimal directory name to 40 characters before comparing all bytes. The complete local Maven mirror was created and verified on the development host, including the previously missing ActiveMQ BOM.

Job 20261127-143502-run-both-original-maven-war-builds-with rebuilds both original Maven plugins and reads the produced WARs.

commits.summary: Measure all 50 Spring Boot changes through their public interfaces (verification pending)
commits.body:
Register the remainder of examples 588–637, including isolated Docker services, actual Actuator and telemetry consumers, executable archives and extracted WARs. On the numbered JVM callers and four separately built integrations, 142 merged predictions matched, four were refuted and four public histories remain open. All 50 unchanged controls matched on both sides. Preserve the raw observations and both merged bytecode checks separately.

Rebuild the original 2017 Boot codec changes on both sides with six contemporaneous Framework sources. Archive the separate M3 release check, native migration and Gradle outputs, retain failed Maven attempts, and validate digest-bound external evidence through the example router. All 64 affected suites passed, the final 20 example registrations passed validation and replay, and the campaign audit, evidence digests and cost lint passed. S48 preflight ran Maven 3.9.13 on a physical WAR with the decoy first.

Independent jobs 20261127-143936-recheck-spring-boot-services-deployments, 20261127-145103-read-both-original-maven-wars-with-a-pin and 20261127-145111-isolate-the-third-class-in-the-gradle-bo repeat the deployments, Maven WAR packaging and isolated Gradle layer challenge.
